repo.description:
### Impact

Ghost renders themes with express-hbs, which contained a denial of service vulnerability ([GHSA-9gg7-283r-5gm9](https://github.com/TryGhost/express-hbs/security/advisories/GHSA-9gg7-283r-5gm9)). Rendering a page containing specific text caused the site to stop responding to all requests until Ghost was restarted, and the problem recurred whenever that page was rendered again.

A staff user with the Contributor role or higher could trigger this. On sites whose theme displays member-provided data, such as a member's name, a member could also trigger it; Ghost's default themes do not display this data.

No data is exposed or modified.

### Vulnerable versions
This vulnerability is present in Ghost up to v6.76.0.

### Patches
v6.77.0 contains a fix for this issue, by updating express-hbs to 4.0.2.

### How to update
For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References
- https://github.com/TryGhost/express-hbs/security/advisories/GHSA-9gg7-283r-5gm9

### For more information
If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, email us at [security@ghost.org](mailto:security@ghost.org).
repo.summary: Denial of Service via Async Helper ID in Theme Data
